title: Matthew / @mtclassic3 — Social & Story Ledger 2026
purpose: Preserve Matthew's recurring public-chat presence as a changing human/social record while keeping creative Matthew-the-Potato material on a separate layer.
source_rule: Real-person chat, conversation recovery and creative projection are separate strata. A fictional Potato ability is never silently promoted into biography.

Matthew uses God/Trinity/Potato language in conversation; keep his exact claims participant-attributed rather than converting them into project doctrine.
Matthew/@mtclassic3 is treated as a real interlocutor for explaining the project's thesis.

He reports getting a new controller, jokes that one day without games nearly made him 'a better person' and start 'conquering the world' but that he would rather conquer Elden Ring, says he just woke up and will check the site soon, then reports finally defeating Ancient Dragon Senessax after more than twenty attempts and describes himself jokingly as a dragon slayer.
